Future<void> work(items) async {
const WIDTH = 4;
const ONE = 1;
for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
}
for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += 2) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
}
for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += WIDTH) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
}
for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += ONE) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
}
for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += unknownWidth) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i]), other(items[i])]);
}
}
